name: Solosancho (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided green over red, with a white vertical stripe one third of the length at the hoist bearing a red castle.
history: The arms and the flag were approved on 24 November 1997 (Boletín Oficial del Estado no. 307 of 24 December 1997); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of two equal horizontal stripes, green above and red below, and a white vertical stripe of one third of the flag next to the staff bearing a red castle.

features.role: hoist stripe one third of the length
